wasmerChanges: Replaced the @astrojs/vercel adapter with @astrojs/node 9.0.3 in standalone mode, because some pages render on the server. Added @astrojs/node to package.json and the lockfile.
Added .nvmrc with Node 24, the Node version Wasmer builds with.
The theme has no lockfile, so this folder adds a package-lock.json generated with npm.
Added a `start` script (`node ./dist/server/entry.mjs`) to package.json so Wasmer can start the Node server.
